verdict.rationale: Pulumi has a well-documented public Registry of providers/packages (referenced implicitly via 'Pulumi Registry providers' in pulumi-docs-1 and the MCP server description 'querying Pulumi Registry information' in pulumi-probe-8), and 300+ providers are consumable per pulumi-gh-2. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of a publishing workflow for developers to submit/publish their own reusable components/packages to the public Registry, versioning/discovery mechanics, or community corroboration of publishing experience. missing for 10: first-party docs on the publish/submission process for community packages, evidence of component/package authoring guides, independent/hands-on confirmation of publishing a package to the Registry.
